title: 反事实的溯因、干预与预测
caption: 在给定结构模型中，事实 S=1 将两点背景的概率从各 1/2 更新为 1/4 与 3/4；随后只改变响应映射，保留同一背景后验。干预映射将两个背景映到 2 与 6，因此条件反事实均值为 5，而沿原背景先验得到的边际干预均值为 4。示例不负责证明结构假设本身有效。
brief: Scientific mechanism: two possible exogenous backgrounds, low and high, initially equally probable. Observing a factual event updates the background probabilities to one-quarter low and three-quarters high. This is abduction, not selection of a single background. An intervention then changes the response map, NOT the individual background. The same intervention map takes low background to outcome 2 and high to outcome 6. Pushing the posterior through this map gives a conditional counterfactual outcome distribution with masses one-quarter at 2 and three-quarters at 6, expected outcome5. Pushing the original equal prior through the SAME intervention map gives equal masses at2 and6, expected outcome4. Depict the update of a two-point background distribution and the same two response endpoints in a clear causal workflow; distinguish the conditional posterior path from the population prior path. A small factual evidence object connects to the update. Exactly two possible backgrounds and two outcome endpoints per distribution, no random-resampling/replacement of the person and no collapsed deterministic result. Corresponding low/high backgrounds and outcomes retain visual identities. Reserve labels for prior, observed fact, abduction, posterior, intervention response map, and outcome. Numeric masses and variables will be typeset later. The intervention module must represent changing a mapping; no syringe, pill, surgery, or misleading physical medical icon. Prefer a compact abstract mechanism rather than a generic infographic. Only the attached two diagrams are external mechanism references, not layouts to copy.
